cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: CALP West and Central Africa CWG leads report (Jul 2026): government leadership, with OCHA, Oxfam and Chad Red Cross supporting coordination. Roles of the supporters are not specified; recorded as coordinator.
cwg_reliefweb.note: No Chad Cash Working Group page found on response.reliefweb.int (tried /chad, /fr/chad, /chad/cash-working-group, /tchad/groupe-de-travail-cash; all failed to load). Latest minutes found: October 2024, posted on ReliefWeb (page body gives no meeting date or chair).

cva_delivered_usd.note: No Chad CWG dashboard or OCHA CVA snapshot with delivered USD found. Related: 192,368 households reached by 63 partners in 2023 (no value, May 2024 regional minutes); WFP alone reported USD 7.5M of CBT in a Sep 2025 monthly estimate; US-OCHA pooled allocation (Dec 2025) plans USD 18.8M of USD 100M as cash transfers. None is a CWG delivered total.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: Only a planned figure found: USD 4.5M MPCA within the US-OCHA allocation (agreement signed Dec 2025, to Nov 2026). Not a delivered amount.

fsps.name: Moov Money (Moov Africa Chad)
used_by: Government of Chad / PARCA project (World Bank-funded)
fsps.evidence: Paid 120,000 FCFA to 22,000 vulnerable N'Djamena households (Aug 2021) and 45,000 FCFA per refugee / 120,000 FCFA per host household at Guilmey (Jun 2022). Government social-protection / refugee-support transfers, not a named humanitarian agency. Both sources are government/World Bank social-protection or refugee programmes (PARCA), not NGO or UN humanitarian cash.

fsps.name: Express Union
fsps.evidence: Selected as FSP for Chad Red Cross direct-cash pilot (Jan-Apr 2025) per Oct 2024 feasibility assessment.

fsps.name: Airtel (mobile money)
fsps.evidence: Existing framework contract with Chad Red Cross that 'requires an update' (Oct 2024); mobile money inferred by the source.

fsps.name: Western Union
fsps.evidence: Cited as an example FSP a framework contract could be signed with; no use shown.
